sentences.Jeg er frisør og jobber på en frisørsalo: I'm a hairdresser and work at a hair salon called Saks & Kam.
sentences.Jeg har gode kollegaer, og jeg møter man: I have good colleagues, and I meet lots of interesting people.
sentences.Jeg liker veldig godt å jobbe som frisør: I really like working as a hairdresser.
Lots of customers get their hair cut with us.
sentences.Først vasker jeg håret til kundene, og e: First I wash the customers' hair, and then I cut it.
sentences.Kundene betaler og går hjem med ny frisy: The customers pay and go home with a new hairstyle.
They feel good about how they look, and that makes me happy.
sentences.Hvordan vil du ha håret?: How would you like your hair?
I usually have it short at the back.
sentences.Skal jeg klippe det kort ved ørene også?: Shall I cut it short around the ears too?
sentences.Ja, takk! Hva koster det å klippe seg he: Yes, please! How much does it cost to get a haircut here?
It's 399 kroner for a men's cut.
